short.q: Write the pinyin for 爸爸, 妈妈 and 姐姐.
short.answer: bàba, māma, jiějie.
short.working: 1 mark for each with the correct tone marks.

short.q: Write the stroke order of 大 in Chinese stroke names.
short.answer: 横, 撇, 捺.
short.working: 2 marks for all three in order, 1 mark for two.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 祝, 妈妈 and 说.
short.answer: 祝: zhù, to wish. 妈妈: māma, mother. 说: shuō, to speak.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Give three things to do when planning a showcase item.
short.answer: Choose an item, decide who does what, list the materials and words needed, practise several times.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write "Happy birthday to you" in characters and pinyin.
short.answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

short.q: Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today is Wednesday." and "On Wednesday I go to school."
short.answer: 今天星期三。 jīntiān xīngqīsān. 我星期三去学校。 wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Write three things you could include in a class display and one thing to check.
short.answer: For example a labelled house plan, a birthday card and character models; check tone marks and stroke order.
short.working: 1 mark for each item and 1 mark for a check.

short.q: Explain two things that help you read a sentence at a good pace.
short.answer: Read it slowly first; join the words together; speak at natural speed; keep the tones clear; record and listen back.
short.working: 2 marks for each explained point.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my eyes to see."
short.answer: 我用眼睛看。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Explain how a good presenter speaks and behaves during a showcase, giving five points.
short.answer: Stands tall and smiles; looks at the audience; says each word clearly with the right tone; speaks at a steady pace and pauses; stays calm and repeats after a mistake.
short.working: 1 mark for each point.

short.q: Write these position words in Chinese with pinyin: beside, above and below.
short.answer: 旁边 pángbiān, 上面 shàngmiàn, 下面 xiàmiàn.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Put these pinyin words in alphabetical order: mǐfàn, bǐng, chá.
short.answer: bǐng, chá, mǐfàn.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct position.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ ài nǐ.
short.answer: I love you.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is the sun."
short.answer: 这是太阳。 zhè shì tàiyáng.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Give three tips for following spoken instructions well.
short.answer: Listen to the whole instruction; catch the key words; ask for a repeat if unsure; show the answer by pointing or drawing.
short.working: 1 mark for each tip.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 朋友 and 肩膀.
short.answer: 朋友: péngyou, friend. 肩膀: jiānbǎng, shoulder.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: jīntiān xià yǔ.
short.answer: Today it rains.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 笑 and 头.
short.answer: 笑: xiào, to laugh, to smile. 头: tóu, head.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bed is in the bedroom." and "The television is on the table."
short.answer: 床在卧室。 chuáng zài wòshì. 电视在桌子上。 diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Write a dialogue of five lines in Chinese with pinyin between two learners about a food picture: ask what it is, answer, ask if they like it, and reply.
short.answer: A: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme? B: 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo. A: 你喜欢吃香蕉吗? nǐ xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo ma? B: 我喜欢。 wǒ xǐhuan. A: 谢谢! xièxie!
short.working: 1 mark for each line with pinyin.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I love you."
short.answer: 我爱你。 wǒ ài nǐ.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Explain the sentence pattern for saying where something is, with an example.
short.answer: Thing + 在 + place, with 上 or 下 at the end when needed. For example 电视在桌子上。
short.working: 1 mark for the pattern, 1 mark for the example, 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Read and translate: 星期一到星期五,去学校。
short.answer: xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ, qù xuéxiào. From Monday to Friday, go to school.
short.working: 1 mark for pinyin and 2 marks for the meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 吃 and 上面.
short.answer: 吃: chī, to eat. 上面: shàngmiàn, above.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write a five-sentence description of your family in Chinese with pinyin, using 这是 and 我家有.
short.answer: 我家有五口人。这是我爸爸。这是我妈妈。这是我哥哥。这是我。 wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. zhè shì wǒ bàba. zhè shì wǒ māma. zhè shì wǒ gēge. zhè shì wǒ.
short.working: 1 mark for each sentence, with pinyin and correct tones.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 谁 and 咖啡.
short.answer: 谁: shéi, who. 咖啡: kāfēi, coffee.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There are five people in my family."
short.answer: 我家有五口人。 wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Write the eight basic strokes' names in Chinese with pinyin. Any six earn full marks.
short.answer: 横 héng, 竖 shù, 撇 piě, 捺 nà, 点 diǎn, 提 tí, 横折 héngzhé, 竖钩 shùgōu.
short.working: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for four, 3 marks for six or more.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The door is on the left."
short.answer: 门在左边。 mén zài zuǒbian.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Compare how Mandarin and Kiswahili name family members. Give two similarities or differences.
short.answer: Similar: both repeat a syllable in words for close family, such as baba and bàba, mama and māma. Different: Mandarin has different words for older and younger brothers and sisters, but Kiswahili uses kaka and dada for both.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct point, up to 4.

short.q: Write a short dialogue of four lines in Chinese with pinyin: two friends greet each other and one says it is their birthday.
short.answer: A: 你好! nǐ hǎo! B: 你好! nǐ hǎo! A: 今天是我的生日。 jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì. B: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
short.working: 1 mark for each correct line, with pinyin.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 你好 and 鸡肉.
short.answer: 你好: nǐ hǎo, hello. 鸡肉: jīròu, chicken (meat).
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: What does the apostrophe in nǚ'ér do?
short.answer: It shows where one syllable ends and the next begins, nǚ + ér.
short.working: 1 mark for each part of the explanation.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My friend gives me a gift."
short.answer: 朋友送我礼物。 péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Decide whether each statement is 对 or 错 and explain. Text: 今天有太阳,没有雨。 Statement: 今天有雨。
short.answer: 错. The text says there is no rain (没有雨).
short.working: 1 mark for 错, 1 mark for finding 没有, 1 mark for the explanation.

short.q: Describe how to work out the meaning of an unknown word in a sentence.
short.answer: Read the whole sentence, look at the words you know, look at pictures, then guess and check with a friend or dictionary.
short.working: 1 mark for each of three steps.

short.q: Explain why a healthy plate should have food from several groups and name two groups with their Chinese names.
short.answer: Each group does a different job. Vegetables and fruit (蔬菜, 水果) give vitamins, rice (米饭) gives energy, and meat (肉) helps the body grow.
short.working: 1 mark for saying groups do different jobs, 1 mark for each group named, 1 mark for the job.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I like to eat bananas."
short.answer: 我喜欢吃香蕉。 wǒ xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 卧室 and 手.
short.answer: 卧室: wòshì, bedroom. 手: shǒu, hand.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Explain what the part 女 tells us in 妈, 姐 and 妹.
short.answer: 女 means woman or female, so the characters are for female family members.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There is a television in the living room."

short.answer: bīngxiāng zài chúfáng. The fridge is in the kitchen. Question: 冰箱在哪儿?

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello, teacher!"
short.answer: 老师好! lǎoshī hǎo!

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today it rains."

short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Give three tips for neat Chinese handwriting.
short.answer: Keep characters the same size, keep strokes firm and straight, leave equal spaces, write in the right stroke order, do not join separate strokes.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Where is the sofa?"
short.answer: 沙发在哪儿? shāfā zài nǎr?

short.q: Write in Chinese and pinyin: "Today it rains."
short.answer: 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.

short.answer: 旁边: pángbiān, beside. 十: shí, ten. 风: fēng, wind.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There is a bed in the bedroom."
short.answer: 卧室里有床。 wòshì lǐ yǒu chuáng.

short.q: Draw the four tone marks over the vowel a and name each tone.
short.answer: ā first tone (high, flat), á second tone (rising), ǎ third tone (dipping), à fourth tone (falling).

short.q: Write the stroke names of 手 in order.
short.answer: 撇, 横, 横, 竖钩.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my father."

short.q: Explain how to pause when reading: what does a comma mean and what does a full stop mean?
short.answer: A comma is a short pause and a full stop is a longer pause, so you can breathe and the listener can follow.

short.q: Describe how to say the initials b and p differently, and give one more pair like them.
short.answer: b is said without a puff of air and p with a puff of air. Another pair is d and t (or g and k). You can test with a paper strip, which moves more with p.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 谢谢 and 听.
short.answer: 谢谢: xièxie, thank you. 听: tīng, to listen, to hear.

short.q: Explain how nǐ hǎo is really said, and why.
short.answer: It is said like ní hǎo, because when two third tones come together, the first changes to a second tone.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 刮风 and 天.
short.answer: 刮风: guā fēng, the wind blows. 天: tiān, sky, day.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door." and "The bathroom is beside the garden."

short.answer: 玩: wán, to play. 右边: yòubian, right side.

short.answer: 小: xiǎo, small. 天气: tiānqì, weather.

short.answer: 浴室: yùshì, bathroom. 四: sì, four.

short.answer: 电视在桌子上。 diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.

short.answer: Fēng lái le, yǔ lái le, xuě yě lái le. The wind has come, the rain has come, the snow has come too.

short.answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!

short.q: Describe how to make the character 手 using local materials.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The television is in the living room."

short.q: Give two habits for keeping your body clean.
short.answer: Wash your hands with soap (洗手), brush your teeth (刷牙), bathe often, wear clean clothes.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 六, 送 and 没有.
short.answer: 六: liù, six. 送: sòng, to give (a gift). 没有: méiyǒu, there is not.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.
